papers.title_en: Improved Approximation for Unsplittable CVRP via a Greedy Approach
papers.evidence: 车辆路径问题的3.159近似，与TSP类路径问题紧密相关
papers.tldr: 本文研究度量空间下不可拆分容量车辆路径问题（unsplittable CVRP），目标是改进其多项式时间近似比。作者在Traub的相对贪心算法基础上，提出平均贪心算法，同时控制路径成本与高需求客户覆盖。结合路径划分变体和匹配算法，最终得到3.159近似算法。该结果刷新了不可拆分CVRP的近似保证，并为贪心与LP舍入方法的结合提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: We devise a polynomial-time $3.159$-approximation algorithm for the metric unsplittable Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem. We build on the Relative Greedy Algorithm suggested by Traub (2025), which can be considered as a variant of the LP rounding algorithm of Friggstad, Mousavi, Rahgoshay, and Salavatipour (2025). Our main ingredient is the Average Greedy Algorithm, a new algorithm that controls both tour costs and the coverage of clients with high demand. This additional control enables a sharper averaging argument for the cost of subsequent greedy choices. Similarly to Zhao and Xiao (2026), combining the Average Greedy with variants of tour partitioning and a matching algorithm yields the final approximation guarantee.

papers.title_en: A Metaheuristic Optimization Framework for Discrete Optimization under Strict Time Limits
papers.authors: Umut Çalıkyılmaz, Nitin Nayak, Sven Groppe
papers.evidence: 面向离散优化的元启发式框架，集成蚁群、遗传与模拟退火，可迁移至ATSP启发式求解。
papers.tldr: 实时应用需在毫秒级为困难离散优化问题找到高质量解，元启发式框架可适应不同计算预算，但现有研究很少把可用时间作为显式分析维度。为此提出STILO，一个面向严格时限的元启发式优化框架，为蚁群、遗传和模拟退火提供细粒度配置空间并融合新算子。实验覆盖合成与基准离散问题，显示SA的离散距离计算机制有效，ACO问题无关图结构的相对效果会随时限变化。结果表明算法族与算子有效性不仅取决于问题类型，还受实例特征和计算预算影响。
papers.abstract_en: Real-time applications often rely on optimization approaches that can find high-quality solutions to hard problems on the order of milliseconds. Metaheuristic optimization frameworks (MOFs) are useful tools for such tasks, as they provide large sets of general-purpose search mechanisms that can return solutions under different computational budgets. However, existing work largely overlooks the available computation time as an explicit dimension of analysis. In this work, we introduce STILO, a MOF specifically designed for optimization under strict time limits. STILO integrates fine-grained configuration spaces for ant colony optimization (ACO), genetic algorithm (GA), and simulated annealing (SA), combining existing and novel operators. We performed experiments using both synthetic and benchmark instances of various discrete optimization problems. The results indicate that the proposed discrete distance calculation mechanism for SA is useful for optimization under strict time limits. They also show that the relative effectiveness of the proposed problem-independent graph structures for ACO can vary across time limits, even for the same instance characteristics. More generally, the results demonstrate that the effectiveness of algorithm families and operators depends not only on the problem type, but also on the characteristics of the instance and the available computational budget.
